crossRefs.note: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahweh, and against his Anointed…
For as long as the son of Jesse lives on the earth, you will not be established, nor will your kingdom. Therefore now…
Saul said to his servants who stood around him, “Hear now, you Benjamites! Will the son of Jesse give everyone of you…
As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people were gathered together, both chief priests and scribes…
The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.
They began to accuse him, saying, “We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and…
The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.
Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.
I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.

translations.web: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.
translations.bsb: Though rulers sit and slander me, Your servant meditates on Your statutes.
translations.kjv: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.
translations.asv: Princes also sat and talked against me; But thy servant did meditate on thy statutes.
